finding: The entity ID_IN_USE gives branch as 'a local branch or a remote-tracking branch'. Since the ST-0376 drift row, BR-099 and the contract of next-id --plan-seed also count the working tree of the current worktree, and _working_tree in packages/factory/scripts/next-id:633 reads it, so a story that no commit holds yet raises the seed. Add the working tree to the attribute, and cite BR-099 in the ID_IN_USE note.
why_this_severity: BR-099 and the contract state the working tree, so an implementer who reads the rule still builds it (no to fails_purpose); a reader of the entity model alone misses one source of IDs in use and must look it up in the rule (raises_cost).
